prompts.note: Opaque node scripts/build.mjs plus git mv of the extensionless directory context/archive/x (a child target starts with that path) plus sed of change.md. No diff, so the git mv targets stay git-made and the markdown edit is documentation. No code edits.

Same opaque build, but git mv old/a.ts new/a.ts is a file move and sed writes src/a.ts. src/a.ts stays a code edit. No check follows, so unchecked. The git mv paths are git-made and raise no unchecked-edit hint.
git rm old/a.ts is git-made even though git rm is not a history op. sed of src/a.ts is the code edit. No check follows, so unchecked, and only src/a.ts is hinted.
